subject: Initial privacy annex request and e-sign preference (CloudVault)

From: Anna Santoro <anna.santoro@cloudvault.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@cloudvault.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Initial privacy annex request — CloudVault / Redwood

Hi Olga,

Nice to meet you (virtually). CloudVault is preparing to onboard Redwood for inference across several product lines and Legal has a few asks before we can proceed to PoC. Can you send your standard Data Processing Annex (DPA) and an up-to-date subprocessor inventory? We also need to understand how Redwood intends to handle cross-border transfers — specifically:

- Whether you rely on EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or another transfer mechanism;
- Whether you have a separate UK addendum or rely on the EU SCCs for transfers to the UK;
- Confirmation of any US-based subprocessors that will have access to customer data; and
- Typical retention periods tied to customer contracts (we'll ask for a data retention schedule).

We prefer electronic signature (DocuSign or AdobeSign) for the DPA. If you have a preferred route, please advise.

Target timeline: we'd like an executed DPA prior to starting the integration sprint next month — ideally within two weeks.

I've attached a short intake PDF that lists the fields our procurement team needs. Let me know if we should loop in your privacy/legal operations contact.

Thanks,
Anna Santoro
Legal Counsel | CloudVault Inc.
anna.santoro@cloudvault.com
Attachment: CloudVault_DPA_Request_v1.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Santoro <anna.santoro@cloudvault.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial privacy annex request — CloudVault / Redwood

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear checklist and the intake PDF. Welcome — excited to get CloudVault onboarded. 

Quick summary of what I'm sending with this message:
- Redwood standard DPA (attached: Redwood_DPA_2026-08-01.pdf)
- Current subprocessors inventory (attached CSV) and a short note about our approach to transfers
- Proposed execution path: DocuSign by default; we can accommodate AdobeSign if you prefer.

Notes on your questions:
- Transfer mechanism: Redwood generally relies on the EU Commission SCCs for transfers from the EU to non-EEA subprocessors. We maintain a transfer-mapping document and supplement with technical/organizational controls.
- UK transfers: we have a small UK addendum template that mirrors the EU SCCs but with UK-specific references. We typically include it when customers request UK-specific language. Do you want us to include the UK addendum with the initial DPA?
- US-based subprocessors: listed in the attached CSV (column: country). Any that will process customer data are flagged.
- Retention: our baseline is contract-driven; the DPA has standard language and we can provide a retention schedule as a separate table if needed.

Marissa — looping you in to handle legal review of any potential redlines and to confirm e-sign preference.

Anna — attaching: Redwood_DPA_2026-08-01.pdf, subprocessors_inventory_2026-09.csv

Next steps: please confirm whether CloudVault prefers the UK addendum included and whether DocuSign or AdobeSign is the preferred route. If you want any changes to the DPA up front, send a redline and Marissa will triage.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_2026-08-01.pdf; subprocessors_inventory_2026-09.csv

Thanks Olga — received the DPA and list. A few quick items after a first pass:

- Redlines: procurement/legal have a couple of modest edits (mainly retention scoped to our product logs and a clarification on subprocessor notification timelines). I've attached our redline (CloudVault_DPA_Redlines.docx).
- UK addendum: yes please include the UK addendum in the signing packet so our UK legal reviewer can confirm.
- E-sign preference: our procurement system is standardized on AdobeSign for all vendor agreements. DocuSign is fine if Redwood requires it, but we would prefer AdobeSign to keep routing consistent.

Can you confirm Marissa will take a look at the attached redline and come back with any comments? If possible we'd like to close this by 14 Oct.

Anna
Attachment: CloudVault_DPA_Redlines.docx
